items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 151:1
items.html: At first, the entire place of BYA was the place of the Klipot. And after the vessels of the ZAT of Nekudim broke, front and back, and fell to BYA, the front and the back were mixed one within the other, and through this the place of BYA also expanded to the aspect of the inner vessels, and thirty Sefirot were made in them, HBD HGT up to the Chazeh [chest] for the inner vessels, and TNHY from the Chazeh and downward for the posterior vessels. However, they were included one within the other before the clarification. And afterwards, in the world of correction, the inner vessels of the ZAT of Nekudim, whose breaking was not because of themselves but because of their being joined with the posterior vessels, were clarified, and they became the ZON of Atzilut. And afterwards the aspect of the posterior of the ZAT was clarified from the Klipot, which are the three worlds BYA. However, not all the posterior, but only the aspect of the front of the posterior, which are the 288 that were included and mixed in the posterior; but the aspect of the Malchuts in them, which are the thirty-two Malchuts called the thirty-two stones, could not be clarified any more, and they remained the aspect of Klipot, in which there is no benefit at all. Therefore, after them, the place of BYA was also divided, for the three worlds BYA, which were clarified from the inner vessels of the posterior, took their place from the Chazeh of the place of BYA and upward. And the Klipot, which are the aspect of the posterior of the posterior, took their place from the Chazeh of the place of BYA and downward, which is related to them. And they are the fourteen Sefirot that became a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, that is, only during the course of six thousand years, at a time when there is no clarification or correction for the thirty-two stones. However, at the completion of the correction, when the coupling of the bottom Hey, which is hidden in RDL"A, is revealed, in the secret of the stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner, then will be fulfilled, and I will remove the heart of stone etc.
